intro: Soft-opening lunch specials. Choose a grill combo, or a complete soup or rice set with no grilling required.

combo.title: Lunch grill combo
combo.note: Choose any two or three grill items. Rice, salad and soup included, with free refills.
combo.footnote: Prices are per person. Add-ons $2 each: Sweet Red Bean with Mochi Drop, Cheesy Sweet Potato.

sets.title: Soup set
sets.choices: Spicy Tofu Stew, Spicy Beef Soup or Miso Soup
sets.servedWith: Served with rice, grilled mackerel, two cold dishes, steamed egg, fresh fruit and a drink (plum nectar, Coke or Sprite).

sets.title: Rice set
sets.choices: Beef Don, Yakiniku Don or Wagyu Fried Rice
sets.servedWith: Served with soup of the day, two cold dishes, steamed egg, fresh fruit and a drink (plum nectar, Coke or Sprite).
